task_name: Supervise recorded calls independently of the API

rubric.result: The complete current diff implements durable preparation before launch and independent ownership of output, deadlines and completion by a detached worker. Prompt and descriptor writes finish before spawn. Output uses file descriptors rather than API-owned pipes. Leader outcome and group enforcement remain independent, preserving enforcement after early leader close and permitting settlement after escalation followed by close. The local-process evidence exercises actual parent exit and descendant termination.

The exact required test reads prompt.md and call.json synchronously inside the first spawn double, checks their contents there, then verifies the full literal descriptor and worker argv. The assertion matches the brief's durable-before-launch requirement. Real-process tests use the local child fixture rather than Claude.

Public signatures, constructor ports and invocation freezing match the task. Descriptor mode must uniquely match the conversation. Immutable preparation precedes detached worker launch; actual child spawn triggers best-effort IPC acceptance. Lost acceptance remains bounded uncertainty without retry. TERM and grace KILL target the group, ESRCH is benign, other signal failures remain diagnostic, and completion publication is guarded once. StoredCompletion now rejects simultaneous code/signal and success without exit zero and null signal before constructing the domain value. Coherent non-success results, unavailable telemetry, valid zeroes and unverified resumed attribution remain readable. Malformed content maps to PlanAgentNotNamed, operational failures to PlanAgentNotLaunched, absence alone returns null for completion, and polling refuses uncertainty after the recorded deadline. All three attempt-3 findings are corrected in the reviewed implementation.

The change preserves the three outer call purposes, TypeScript modules, immutable record-based identity, separate execution and measurements, and unverified resumed cost. It adds no persistent production pid, automatic replay, per-step backend automaton, gate, feature flag, metrics ingestion or plugin mutation. Process-group checks belong to active supervision rather than restart discovery. The remaining closed decisions are untouched.

Read the current ct-judge role and all eight convention documents from the package's authorized worktree-370 paths, and applied them with the repository conventions and relevant process/persistence exemplars already read. Dependencies point inward, collaborators and bounds are injected, conversion stays in boundary models, and the entrypoint assembles concrete collaborators. Closed vocabulary: purpose, mode, leader outcome, enforcement, execution and cost have explicit alternatives; unknown persisted classifications are rejected. Raw map as the return value of logic: supervision publication uses named frozen WorkerOutcome with frozen diagnostics; completion conversion uses the existing typed domain shapes. Two fields that have to agree: leader outcome and enforcement represent distinct facts, while prescribed persisted termination fields now receive coherence validation at their boundary. Errors named for where rather than what: no new location-named family is introduced; the existing PlanAgentNotNamed and PlanAgentNotLaunched causes now distinguish content from operational failure, including construction and EEXIST comparisons. No remaining convention finding is established.

The staged task diff adds five files and removes no pre-existing tests or assertions. The recovery preserves lifecycle and real-process assertions and strengthens corruption tests with sibling-error exclusion and diagnostic checks. Earlier uncommitted attempts are not substituted for the task's baseline.

Production code performs preparation, process launch, group enforcement, output capture and completion conversion. Lifecycle doubles supply external events and clock control while assertions observe production-written completion files. Corrupt stored records are independently seeded through filesystem fixtures, not generated by the parser under test. Real-process fixtures supply output and descendants; the production worker supplies survival, signaling and completion. The fixes are not confined to test scaffolding.

All five staged files serve task 4. Recovery-specific corrections stay in claude-calls.ts and its unit tests, as task-4-recovery-guidance.md specifies; the worker, child fixture and real-process evidence remain intact. Coherence validation, error translation, immutable-collision handling and their tests implement existing scoped obligations. No plan amendment, protected plugin change, domain hardening outside the task, routing change, recovery driver, metrics change or live capture is included. Recovery guidance was treated as architectural context, not a predetermined verdict.

Read all current test additions and used the CT TDD text read directly earlier in this review session after the skill alias proved unavailable. Tests exercise real adapter behavior with temporary roots, literal stored payloads, explicit boundary doubles and an injected lifecycle clock. Assertions cover both close/escalation orderings, once-only publication, signal diagnostics, contradictory termination rejection, coherent unsuccessful completion, unavailable telemetry, resumed attribution, operational/content error separation and zero writes/spawns on invalid invocation. Local-process tests retain condition-based polling and cleanup. No defect of determinism, isolation or real-behavior verification is established. Controls4 success is inherited; .agent/run-331/task-4-controls-4.log is only the supplied log reference. No shell, tests, subagents or Claude calls were run for this judgement.
